adjudication_summary: Consolidated historical Work Router versions v0.1-v0.9 and the cross-class goal solver into canonical src/mapeogeo/routing/. Enforced strict architectural boundaries: routing proposes admissible work paths (D_t(Q) -> Router -> {R_1,...,R_n}); the Wave-4 kernel retains decision authority over utility, certification, and state transition. RouteRegistry directly references the Wave-3 DecisionGraph substrate without duplicating graph primitives.

sources.relation_semantics: Validity > resolvability > cost ordering. Uncertified shortcuts strictly rejected.
sources.invariants: Cheapest uncertified shortcut never executes over certified path.
sources.v2_disposition: ADOPT fail-closed routing logic and outcome semantics into Router.

sources.relation_semantics: Phasor/energy calculations, compute load, and materialization differentiation.
sources.invariants: Scalar approximations cannot certify higher-dimensional distributions (RMS cannot certify THD).
sources.v2_disposition: ADOPT extensible resource envelope {CPU, RAM, GPU, NPU, energy, custom} into ResourceRequirement.

sources.relation_semantics: Cryptographic route verification and audit receipts.
sources.invariants: Uncertified routes cannot emit RouteCertificate; certificates bind exact edge IDs and cost.
sources.v2_disposition: ADOPT cryptographic seal generation into RouteCertificate.

sources.relation_semantics: Multi-stage pipeline execution: R = T_n circ ... circ T_1.
sources.invariants: Stage output types must match successor stage input types.
sources.v2_disposition: ADOPT formal typed word composition Post(T_i) |= Pre(T_{i+1}) into Route.is_valid_composition().

sources.relation_semantics: Tolerance-constrained Pareto shortest path search with validity predicates.
sources.invariants: Routes exceeding error tolerance or violating contract validity are strictly excluded.
sources.v2_disposition: ADOPT error tolerance and context validity checks into WorkContract and Router.

sources.relation_semantics: Goal-directed work decomposition and authority credential verification.
sources.invariants: can_execute != authorized_to_execute; terminal states must be explicit and uncompromised.
sources.v2_disposition: ADOPT Goal, GoalConstraint, GoalSolver, and formal terminal states into MAPEOGEOv2.
